newsitem.title: USA: U.S. barge rates - Quoted at mostly steady levels.
newsitem.headline: U.S. barge rates - Quoted at mostly steady levels.

text.p: U.S. barge rates were quoted at mostly steady levels on Tuesday on the St. Louis Merchants Exchange call session. No barges traded versus none on Monday.
- Two barges, Illinois River, this week, no bid, offered down 2-1/2 points at 107-1/2 percent of tariff.
- Two barges, mid-Mississippi River, next week, bid 2.5 points higher at 117-1/2 percent, no offer.
- Eight barges, Illinois River, two each week July, offered 2-1/2 points lower at 112-1/2 percent, bid at 107-1/2 percent of tariff.
- Four barges, Illinois River, one each week September, offered at a steady 175 percent, no bid.
- Four barges, mid-Mississippi River, one each week October, offered at a steady 245 percent, no bid.
- Four barges, Illinois River, one each week October, offered steady at 240 percent of tariff, no bid.
- Five barges, Illinois River, one each week November, offered steady at 185 percent of tariff, no bid.
- Eight barges, Illinois River, two each week December, offered steady at 170 percent of tariff, no bid.
